name: asterweave
description: Graph paths woven into reliable delivery through evidence-backed repository scaffolding, deterministic orchestration, bounded engineering loops, specialist subagents, stack-aware quality gates, and GitHub or Azure DevOps issue-to-PR automation.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with access only to repositories and operations you want Asterweave to use.

ado_organization.title: Azure DevOps organization
ado_organization.description: Optional. Azure DevOps organization name, only needed when a repository sets provider.workItems: azure-devops in .claude/asterweave.json.

ado_pat_base64.title: Azure DevOps PAT (base64)
ado_pat_base64.description: Optional. Base64 of "<email>:<personal-access-token>" for Azure DevOps, as required by the official Azure DevOps MCP server. Leave unset unless using Azure DevOps.
